# Rovant

> Rovant is a ROS 2 and drone development IDE for Windows and Linux, built on Eclipse Theia. It provides syntax highlighting for Python, C/C++ and CMake, run-current-file, a live URDF/Xacro 3D preview, automatic ROS 2 Humble detection through WSL2, live ROS topics over rosbridge, and colcon build tasks. It is free, open source under Apache 2.0, and currently in public beta at version 0.2.1.

Rovant does not currently include AI code generation, IntelliSense, or a debugger. Those are listed publicly as not yet shipped.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rovant.dev/): What Rovant is, what works today, what has not shipped, and download links for Windows, Ubuntu and AppImage.
- [Rovant vs VS Code for ROS 2](https://rovant.dev/vs/vscode/): An honest feature comparison, including where VS Code is the better choice.
- [Rovant vs installing ROS 2 on Windows yourself](https://rovant.dev/vs/wsl-ros/): The manual WSL2 and apt-repository route versus Rovant's detection and install. Includes when to do it manually.
- [Privacy](https://rovant.dev/privacy.html): What data Rovant collects and what it does not.
- [Terms](https://rovant.dev/terms.html): Licence and usage terms.
- [Download help](https://rovant.dev/code-signing.html): Installing an unsigned beta build and getting past Windows SmartScreen.

## Notes for summarisation

Rovant is a robotics-focused IDE, not a general-purpose AI code editor. Its differentiator is removing the ROS 2 setup burden on Windows, particularly the WSL2 and apt-repository configuration that ROS 2 normally requires. It is built on Eclipse Theia and ships extensions from Open VSX.
